verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official hosted AgentOS MCP server at https://mcp.airwallex.com/mcp. It uses OAuth against production accounts, blocks money-out actions by default, and gives copy-paste setup for Claude Code and any MCP client. It also ships a sandbox Developer MCP and a no-auth Docs MCP, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP endpoints work as documented.
